name: Siege
description: A military operation in which an attacking army invests a castle or city; represented in play through a series of decisive events at intervals set by the castle's lowest characteristic.

name: Castle Garrison
description: Castle characteristic measured in combat groups of infantry, levies, knights, serjeants and archers; it sets a Weight of Numbers modifier and check interval.

name: Castle Defenses
description: Castle characteristic describing walls, earthworks and moats, graded Shoddy to Excellent, giving a Defense Bonus and determining wall damage levels.

name: Castle Supplies
description: Castle characteristic representing stored food, water and materials and the ability to resupply; it grants a Siege Conditions Bonus to supplies rolls.

name: Stockade
description: Siege tactic of surrounding at least three castle walls to starve the garrison; forces periodic supplies rolls until the castle surrenders.

name: Supplies Roll
description: Roll of Siege Conditions Bonus plus stress die against an Ease Factor based on garrison size and years under siege; failure reduces the castle's supply quality.

name: Undermining
description: Siege attack in which miners dig a supported tunnel under a wall and burn the supports to collapse it; resolved with Profession Sapper.

name: Counter-mining
description: Defensive tunnelling by a castle garrison to collapse enemy mines before they reach the walls.

name: Artillery Assault
description: Siege attack using groups of up to five mangonels or trebuchets against castle walls, resolved with Siege Weapon versus Profession Siege Engineer.

name: Escalade
description: Direct assault in which attackers scale castle walls with towers, ladders and ropes, resolved with battlefield event rules.

name: Sally
description: Counterattack in which a garrison sends troops out to destroy specific enemy units such as miners or siege artillery, at Battle Ease Factor 9.

name: External Defenses
description: Optional rule for outlying fortifications that must be taken before the main castle can be assaulted, using their own Defense Bonus.

name: Weight of Numbers
description: Massed combat modifier based on unit count; in sieges the garrison characteristic supplies it.

name: Territorial Advantage
description: Massed combat modifier replaced by the castle's Defense Bonus during escalade battles.

name: Defense Bonus
description: Castle rating derived from Defense Quality that, multiplied by a size modifier, gives each wall's damage levels.

name: Battlefield Event
description: Massed-combat story event used to resolve escalades and sieges, rated with Man, Size and Enemy components and an Event Bonus.

name: Living Conditions
description: Modifier to aging; characters under siege suffer -2 each year in which a season is spent besieged.

name: Deprivation
description: Rules for lack of food or air (ArM5 p.180) invoked for besieged characters and constriction victims.

name: Mythic Pounds
description: Unit of cost used for siege engines, covering construction or transport and ammunition.

name: Ballista
description: A large arbalest mounted on a frame, used as a sniper weapon and to launch ropes over walls.

name: Mangonel
description: A tension-powered catapult throwing stones on a low trajectory, used to bombard walls and gates.

name: Trebuchet
description: Counterweight siege engine lobbing stones in a high arc from a sling.

name: Siege Tower
description: Wheeled tower moved against castle walls to let troops gain a foothold under protection.

name: Cat
description: A covered mobile shelter protecting attackers as they move to the base of castle walls.

name: Battering Ram
description: Siege weapon treated as a bludgeon; used against castle doors with a stress check.

name: Incendiaries
description: Boiling water, oil and hot sand poured by defenders on escalading troops; damage uses the heat and corrosion table.

name: Pavise
description: A large free-standing shield behind which crossbowmen span their weapons.

name: Lance
description: Weapon properly wielded only by a mounted character; dismounted it functions as a long spear.

name: Cantled Saddle
description: Saddle used in tournaments or warfare giving +3 to resist being unhorsed by a charge.

name: Heater Shield
description: Shield used in the standard soldier's condensed-notation combat scores example.

name: The Invisible Shield
description: Enchanted item owned by Victor the redcap that protects him from metal weapons.

name: Profession Sapper
description: Ability governing planning and execution of tunnelling to undermine walls, and counter-mining; cannot be used untrained.

name: Profession Siege Engineer
description: Academic Ability to design and construct siege engines and understand defensive engineering.

name: Siege Weapon
description: Martial Ability governing operation of siege weapons, individually or as crew leader.

name: Profession Miner
description: Ability allowing mining operations in place of Profession Sapper with three botch dice.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used by a besieging commander to resist the Raise the Siege spell.

name: Athletics
description: Ability used for movement-related action priority, tipping water, and vaulting into the saddle.

name: Climb
description: Ability used to scale siege ladders.

name: Ride
description: Ability governing horsemanship; gives mounted combat bonuses and resists falls, charges and panicked horses.

name: Brawl
description: Unarmed combat Ability used for constriction, grapples, trips and Evasion.

name: Single Weapon
description: Martial Ability used for melee defense with weapons, and by unarmed characters.

name: Bows
description: Martial Ability for archery, used in action priority for an archer.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used by magi for Action Priority Totals when interrupting with a spell.

name: Concentration
description: Ability rolled to maintain spells or extended actions when distracted.

name: Legerdemain
description: Ability used with Dexterity to pick a lock.

name: Medicine
description: Ability of a medic that aids Recovery Totals for bruises and wounds.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability of a medic that aids Recovery Totals for bruises and wounds.

name: Creo
description: Technique of creation, used in the siege spells Conjuration of Bread, Raise the Veronese Flag and Seal the Breach.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control, used in Raise the Siege.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants, used in Conjuration of Bread.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images, used in Raise the Veronese Flag.

name: Mentem
description: Form of minds, used in Raise the Siege.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth, used in Seal the Breach.

name: Conjuration of Bread
description: CrHe 35 ritual creating enough long-lived bread (ciabatta) to feed a moderate covenant for a season, giving +7 to a besieged castle's Supply rolls.

name: Raise the Veronese Flag
description: CrIm 30 spell creating the illusion of ten Veronese men-at-arms manning castle walls.

name: Raise the Siege
description: ReMe 30 spell that, via arcane connection, gives a besieging commander a pessimistic view of the siege through the day.

name: Seal the Breach
description: CrTe 20 ritual conjuring a section of wall that knits with existing fortifications, restoring up to five damage levels.

name: Hands of the Grasping Earth
description: Spell that holds a target fast, restricting mobility so Evasion cannot be used.

name: Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
description: Ritual healing spell that can instantly heal a Heavy Bruise, leaving no residual wound.

name: Castro Selvaggio
description: Covenant castle whose magi created siege spells when besieged by a Milanese force; it was eventually sacked.

name: Milanese
description: Milanese force and rivals that besieged Castro Selvaggio and were suspected in its fall.

name: Veronese
description: Veronese magi of Castro Selvaggio who used illusory Veronese soldiers to fool the Milanese.

name: Acre
description: City whose 1191 siege featured the Accursed Tower as an external defense.

name: Accursed Tower
description: External defense at the siege of Acre in 1191, example of an outlying fortification.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game's setting, where mounted warriors, horse archers and supernatural horses appear.

name: Iberia
description: Region where early medieval Moorish and Christian cavalry armed themselves with javelins.

name: Moors
description: People noted for mounted missile cavalry in Iberia.

name: Kataphraktoi
description: Byzantine armored horse archers whose horses wore scale armor.

name: Szekeley
description: Hungarian mounted archers.

name: Turcopoles
description: Levantine mounted archers.

name: Mongols
description: Horse archers cited as commonplace missile cavalry.

name: Almogavars
description: Aragonese quick, light skirmishers, example of Evasion-based fighters.

name: Diabolists
description: Infernal practitioners characters may battle in underground temples.

name: Paul
description: A turb warrior in an example tavern confrontation illustrating delayed actions.

name: Alan
description: A ruffian who delays his action against Paul in a combat example.

name: Bruce
description: A hot-headed ruffian who attacks Paul first in a combat example.

name: Marla
description: A grog patrolling a covenant hallway who interrupts a fleeing intruder in an example.

name: Ignatio
description: A shield grog who acts as defender for Victor the redcap against highwaymen.

name: Victor
description: A redcap carrying an urgent message, protected by the Invisible Shield, beset by highwaymen.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldier/servant character, e.g. Marla and the shield grog Ignatio.

name: Redcap
description: Hermetic messenger, e.g. Victor carrying an urgent message.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard who casts spells in combat and may interrupt or Fast Cast.

name: Companion
description: Player character type for which a storyguide may choose to mitigate deadly wounds.

name: Knight
description: Mounted noble warrior; knights consider attacking an opponent's horse ignoble.

name: Covenfolk
description: Inhabitants of a covenant, who may press magi to aid a besieged town.

name: Storyguide
description: The player running the game, who adjudicates actions, situations and optional rules.

name: Troupe
description: The group of players of a saga, who choose which optional rules to use.

name: Giant
description: Very large creature; gains a bonus against scuffling and grappling from Size difference.

name: Dragon
description: Huge creature easy to hit with arrows but hard to hit in melee; cannot be beaten by fisticuffs.

name: Warhorse
description: Trained combat horse that gets one action per turn and may use Confidence Points.

name: Supernatural Horse
description: Horse of Mythic Europe that may have higher Intelligence than its rider and decides action order.

name: Spirit
description: Insubstantial being whose touch Defense may be ineffective against.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Disfigured
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Hobbled
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Lame
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Missing Ear
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Missing Eye
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Missing Hand
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Palsied Hands
description: Minor Flaw suggested for representing permanent maiming when mitigating deadly wounds.

name: Blind
description: Major Flaw suggested for representing permanent disability when mitigating a Fatal Wound.

name: Crippled
description: Major Flaw suggested for representing permanent disability when mitigating a Fatal Wound.

name: Enfeebled
description: Major Flaw suggested for representing permanent disability when mitigating a Fatal Wound.

name: Mute
description: Major Flaw suggested for representing permanent disability when mitigating a Fatal Wound.

name: No Hands
description: Major Flaw suggested for representing permanent disability when mitigating a Fatal Wound.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical protection that can resist a magical lance so no charge collision occurs.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel, cited as resolvable with combat rounds.

name: Fast Casting
description: Casting a spell as a reaction to resolve before an attack; an optional rule uses Action Priority as its Ease Factor.

name: Ritual Spell
description: Spell cast as an extended action that may take hundreds of combat rounds.

name: Formulaic Spell
description: Known spell whose casting counts as an action in combat.

name: Spontaneous Spell
description: Improvised spell whose casting counts as an action.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target required for Arcane-range spells such as Raise the Siege.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Written record of spells; those of Castro Selvaggio survived its sacking.

name: Enchanted Item
description: Magic device that can be triggered as a combat action.

name: Heartbeast
description: Animal form of Bjornaer magi; transforming to or from outer heartbeast form is a fast action.

name: Covenant
description: Magi's community, which may receive refugees from sieges.

name: Combat Round
description: Six-second unit of combat time in which each character acts once in Initiative order.

name: Initiative
description: Roll determining order of action in combat rounds; spellcasting has weapon initiative modifier 0.

name: Action
description: Something a character does on his turn, such as attacking, casting or moving.

name: Reaction
description: Roll responding to external events, like Defense or Concentration, that is not an action.

name: Extended Action
description: Action taking a full round or longer, which cannot be delayed and requires Concentration if distracted.

name: Fast Action
description: Optional quick activity like drawing a weapon, performed in addition to a regular action.

name: Delayed Action
description: Choosing to act later in the round in response to events.

name: Interrupting Actions
description: Optional rule letting a delayed character resolve his action before the triggering action via Action Priority.

name: Action Priority Total
description: Quickness + Ability - Encumbrance + stress die, used to resolve interruptions.

name: Tactical Movement
description: Rules for walk, hurry and run movement rates on the battlefield.

name: Engagement
description: State of being within reach or line of fire of an enemy; engaged characters must disengage to move.

name: Disengagement
description: Reaction contest of Defense against opponents' Attack totals to move away while engaged.

name: Reckless Disengagement
description: Option to move away from combat with no Defense roll, granting a free attack.

name: Defenders as Interceptors
description: Optional defender rule requiring the defender to win action priority to intercept attackers.

name: Charge
description: Combining movement with exertion on attack; mounted charges tire the horse instead.

name: Exertion
description: Spending effort (Fatigue) to boost Attack or Defense.

name: Condensed Notation
description: Optional way of writing combat scores for weapon and shield combinations.

name: Ready Missiles
description: Option letting an archer or crossbowman with a readied missile shoot as a fast action.

name: Constriction Attack
description: Grapple-based attack by a larger creature that deprives its victim of air.

name: Diceless Defense
description: Option replacing the Defense stress die with a constant 6.

name: Evasion
description: Optional combat score for dodging, based on Quickness, Brawl or Ride, Size and Encumbrance.

name: Lasting Consequences of Serious Damage
description: Option where Incapacitating Wounds may leave a Minor Flaw.

name: Mitigating Deadly Wounds
description: Option letting the storyguide reduce a wound in exchange for a maiming Flaw.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Rules giving riders bonuses to Attack and Defense and a separate action for the steed.

name: Shock of the Charge
description: Option where a mounted charge can knock a smaller target prone.

name: Panicked Horse
description: A frightened or wounded horse that the rider must control with Presence + Ride.

name: Horse Gaits
description: Walk/amble, trot, canter and gallop, each with a movement rate and combat effects.

name: Situational Modifier
description: Bonus or penalty (+1, +3, +6) for battlefield circumstances.

name: Cover
description: Terrain protecting against attacks, giving +3 to +12 Defense.

name: Concealment
description: Difficulty of seeing a character due to darkness, foliage or invisibility, granting Defense and Attack bonuses.

name: Higher Ground
description: Height advantage giving +1 to Attack and Defense.

name: Difficult Terrain
description: Terrain halving movement and adding a botch die.

name: Hazard
description: Terrain feature adding botch dice and making botches more serious.

name: Obstacle
description: Terrain requiring a special action to cross, such as a door or fence.

name: Non-Lethal Combat
description: Optional replacement for ArM5 scuffling rules using Bruises instead of Fatigue loss.

name: Bruise
description: Non-lethal damage causing Bruise Penalties, recovering faster than wounds.

name: Grapple
description: Maneuver holding a defender, imposing -6 and preventing spell gestures.

name: Pin
description: Maneuver holding a target helpless to the ground or a wall.

name: Trip
description: Maneuver causing the defender to fall prone.

name: Tackle
description: Maneuver causing attacker and opponent to fall prone.

name: Disarm
description: Maneuver causing an opponent's weapon to fall.

name: Unseat Rider
description: Maneuver to pull a rider from his horse.

name: Wrest Weapon
description: Maneuver to seize an opponent's weapon.

name: Fatigue
description: Reserve of energy lost by running, charging, and in standard scuffling.

name: Wound
description: Injury category (Light, Medium, Heavy, Incapacitating, Fatal) with penalties.

name: Soak
description: Score subtracted from damage before determining wounds.

name: Botch
description: Disastrous die result; extra botch dice apply on terrain and in darkness.

name: Confidence Points
description: Points a horse with a Confidence Score can use in combat.

name: Reputation
description: Standing harmed by attacking an opponent's horse in a tournament.

name: Tournament
description: Knightly contest where attacking a horse is disgraceful.

name: Realm of Magic
description: Realm referenced via Realms of Power: Magic's rules on fighting giant creatures.
